support_proof: Fix the original sector/domain/background and all exterior conditioning, so H_(1,Lambda1) is an exterior parameter, not a function of the inner free a_D. The1.22 maps act independently on the specified raw free bonds in S1; their switch g(a_b) and one-bond Jacobians depend only on those exterior inputs and fixed H.

Write the ORIGINAL bare first exponent as the actual finite sum of Wilson and soft-gauge primitives plus free/selected Haar and selected-Jacobian terms, retaining carrierwise classical Taylor pieces and current-corrected quadratic as1694/1616. Under h-4>R_star, no such complete free-input carrier can meet both D and changed S1.

For a primitive meeting D, none of its inputs is changed by T_H. For a changed primitive, all its free inputs are exterior. Therefore the exact exponent difference L(T_H(a_D,e))-L(a_D,e) depends only on e. The raw T_H Jacobian also depends only on e. Original outside characteristic functions are pushed into the outer weight, without dividing by a possibly zero indicator.

Likewise Q_D,E (T_H(e)-e)=0 by the same precision support. At fixed original U1, the inner Gaussian precision and its cross forcing/conditional completion center are unchanged by this far-exterior coordinate change. This statement is about the bare finite matrix and does not integrate out physical gauge fibers.

Hence the UNEXPANDED explicit coordinate-change multiplier of1662 can be kept as an exterior factor R_H(e) for this separated bare branch: the four inner coefficients have the common form R_H(e) times the corresponding original inner integrals, with the marks still composed with the genuine exterior transport where required. Do not confuse R_H with the resummed logarithmic B^(1).
